premise: Pinecone shuts tight in the rain and Bird thinks she's cross; when the sun comes out she opens wide.
inspiration: The North Wind and the Sun (Aesop), taken gently and literally: the rain closes, the sun opens, and a misunderstanding clears with the sky.
lesson: What looks like a grump might just be a friend keeping dry.
learning: Pinecones close up when it is wet and open when it is dry

en-US.title: Pinecone Opens Up
en-US.text: Bird {bird:hop} wanted to play with Pinecone. But then… {canvas:rain 0.6 26s} {sfx:rain-bed} pitter-patter, the rain began. {pinecone:face sleeping} And Pinecone closed up tight. {pinecone:shake} Every little scale folded in, snap, snap, snap. {bird:face sad} [sad] Oh no, said Bird. Pinecone is cross with me. The mushroom {mushroom:wobble} shook her wet cap. {mushroom:face happy} [softly] She isn't cross, she said. Pinecones always close up in the rain. Wait for the sun. So they waited. Drip… drop… drip. And then {canvas:sunshine 0.9 16s} out came the sun, warm and golden. {pinecone:face happy} {bird:face surprised} [gasps] Slowly, slowly, Pinecone opened up, {pinecone:glow} one scale at a time, wide as a smile. [happily] I'm not cross, she {pinecone:wobble} laughed. I was just keeping dry! {bird:face happy} And Squirrel {squirrel:hop} came running, and they all played until bedtime.

es-ES.title: Piña se abre
es-ES.text: Pájaro {bird:hop} quería jugar con Piña. Pero entonces… {canvas:rain 0.6 26s} {sfx:rain-bed} plic, ploc, empezó a llover. {pinecone:face sleeping} Y Piña se cerró bien cerrada. {pinecone:shake} Todas sus escamitas se juntaron, clac, clac, clac. {bird:face sad} [sad] Ay, no, dijo Pájaro. Piña se ha enfadado conmigo. La seta {mushroom:wobble} sacudió su sombrero mojado. {mushroom:face happy} [softly] No está enfadada, dijo. Las piñas siempre se cierran cuando llueve. Espera al sol. Así que esperaron. Plic… ploc… plic. Y entonces {canvas:sunshine 0.9 16s} salió el sol, calentito y dorado. {pinecone:face happy} {bird:face surprised} [gasps] Poco a poco, Piña se abrió, {pinecone:glow} escama a escama, grande como una sonrisa. [happily] ¡No estaba enfadada!, {pinecone:wobble} se rio. ¡Solo me estaba protegiendo del agua! {bird:face happy} Y Ardilla {squirrel:hop} llegó corriendo, y jugaron todos hasta la hora de dormir.

rain-bed.prompt: a light spring shower pattering on leaves and moss
